Tier Green

Duration 1 round

Effect each ally who can hear you gains +1 circumstance to attack rolls or checks made against a called-out threat

Call out a threat so the whole squad can act on it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Each ally who can hear the caster gains +1 circumstance to attacks/checks against a called-out threat, for 1 round. This class's own convention for a flat ally-numeric bonus is a companion type:"effect" record (13 real examples in this corpus); no deadhand.eyes-up-effect.json exists, and a bare ally bonus grant (not an action grant) doesn't match the real precedent found for mass ally action grants (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/actions/class/commander/*.json).
